topic.source_contract: River basin management plans, water-body status and objectives evidence

facts.guard: RBMP is not a site permit or water sample
classification is water-body scale, not parcel water quality
objective is not achieved status or project approval
programme progress is not local completion evidence
future consultation is not current plan replacement

scope_guards: River basin plans, water-body classifications and objectives are distinct evidence layers.
Ecological status, ecological potential and chemical status must not be silently merged.
A water-body classification is not an exact parcel, outfall or drinking-water result.
An objective is a planned outcome and not proof that status has been achieved.
Programme-of-measures and progress reports are not completed local interventions.
The current 2022 plans remain operative until formally replaced.
Water-body status is not planning permission, discharge permit, abstraction licence or development capacity.
No score or promotion is written without exact water body, monitoring, pressures, permits, proposal and planning evidence.
